name: Ray Tracing Backward Pass
aliases: Backward Ray Tracing with Spherical Harmonics
Ray Tracing Backward Pass — Plenoxel Ray Tracing (Backward)
definition: The backward pass for volume rendering, computing gradients for spherical harmonic coefficients, ray origins/directions, and optionally accumulating gradients for background and sparsity/beta losses.
summary: The Ray Tracing Backward Pass computes gradients for spherical harmonic coefficients and density by propagating error signals backward through ray integration, serving as the differentiable counterpart to forward ray casting.
